summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, advertising, and security-sensitive release. Keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms restrict the proposed public/commercial use. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary reversible fleet growth remains conditional only when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is still missing. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix; deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; GA4 consent, withdrawal, property, data-sharing, retention, and jurisdiction evidence; log-field, vendor, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request inventory; accuracy/freshness controls; and rollback evidence. Route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel before any owner-authorized outreach or launch decision.

Continue only the existing authorized analytics-permission and collector work. Recorded GSC access errors affect arttoGogh.com, girlpain.com, and SearchWoot; unavailable impressions, clicks, conversions, and revenue remain unknown and must not be treated as zero. Acceptance is timestamped source-health evidence or a documented blocker with owner and next action. Do not request duplicate telemetry or expand tracking.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Their concrete launch decision remains blocked because dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence is incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one dated readiness packet per property to the existing work item. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or new queue entry is cleared.

Preserve the 2026-09-21 Amazon result as aggregate and unattributed: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission under tracking ID other. Named rows are mapped, but aggregate earnings cannot be assigned to a site. Keep matching-period costs, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and causal lift unknown; require registered tracking IDs for new affiliate links and authorize no spend or monetization expansion.

Fleet compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 35 passes, 18 failures, and 6 unknowns, with open banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is broadly configured but quality is yellow because permissions or collector errors remain. Do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry, but block public exposure where compliance, rights, privacy, security, claims, provenance, platform-policy, or launch evidence is missing. Continue containment-only execution while existing evidence and repair work proceeds.
